content:
format: rulespec/v1
module:
  summary: 'Complete Schedule M for interest paid in 2025 on a student loan granted

    to you, or for unused interest carried forward. “Add lines 46 and 48.”

    “Subtract line 60 from line 52.”'
  proof_validation:
    required: true
  source_verification:
    corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
    source_sha256: e8a905d1a3e9dd708c46ffc0090fafeeeb5c840a0c708a8c80dff2674b78c90a
units:
- name: CAD
  kind: currency
  minor_units: 2
inputs:
- name: schedule_m_carryforward_calculated_for_2024
  entity: Person
  dtype: Boolean
  period: Year
- name: schedule_m_unused_student_loan_interest_line_46
  entity: Person
  dtype: Money
  unit: CAD
  period: Year
- name: schedule_m_student_loan_interest_paid_1998_through_2024
  entity: Person
  dtype: Money
  unit: CAD
  period: Year
- name: schedule_m_student_loan_interest_used_for_previous_year_credits
  entity: Person
  dtype: Money
  unit: CAD
  period: Year
- name: schedule_m_student_loan_interest_paid_2025_line_48
  entity: Person
  dtype: Money
  unit: CAD
  period: Year
- name: schedule_m_student_loan_interest_claimed_line_60
  entity: Person
  dtype: Money
  unit: CAD
  period: Year
- name: schedule_m_decided_to_carry_2024_student_loan_interest_to_future_year
  entity: Person
  dtype: Boolean
  period: Year
  description: Explicit prior carry decision separate from whether2024 calculation
    occurred; never inferred from positive money or treated alone as entitlement.
- name: is_completing_student_loan_interest_schedule
  entity: Person
  dtype: Boolean
  period: Year
  description: Explicit claimant form-use context, not eligibility, filing completed
    or enclosure compliance.
- name: wants_to_keep_student_loan_interest_schedule_copy
  entity: Person
  dtype: Boolean
  period: Year
  description: Explicit wish to keep a copy of this schedule; not actual retention
    or guide consultation.
rules:
- name: schedule_m_unused_student_loan_interest_for_2025_line_46
  kind: derived
  entity: Person
  dtype: Money
  unit: CAD
  period: Year
  source: Revenu Quebec Schedule M 2025, instructions for line 46
  metadata:
    proof:
      atoms:
      - path: versions[0].formula
        kind: condition
        source:
          corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
          excerpt: Also complete this schedule if, for 2024, you calculated an amount
            for interest paid on a student loan and decided to carry the amount forward
      - path: versions[0].formula
        kind: definition
        source:
          corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
          excerpt: or the amount shown in this respect on your 2024 notice of assessment
      - path: versions[0].formula
        kind: formula
        source:
          corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
          excerpt: interest paid for 1998 through 2024 minus the interest already
            used to calculate a credit for interest paid on a student loan for previous
            years.
      - path: versions[0].formula
        kind: unit
        source:
          corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
          excerpt: a student loan granted to you
      - path: versions[0].effective_from
        kind: effective_period
        source:
          corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
          excerpt: Interest paid in 2025 on a student loan
      - path: versions[0].effective_from
        kind: effective_period
        source:
          corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
          excerpt: Revenu Quebec Schedule M 2025 - Interest Paid on a Student Loan
      - path: versions[0].effective_to
        kind: effective_period
        source:
          corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
          excerpt: Revenu Quebec Schedule M 2025 - Interest Paid on a Student Loan
      - path: versions[0].formula
        kind: formula
        source:
          corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
          excerpt: 'Also complete this schedule if, for 2024, you calculated an amount
            for interest paid on a student loan and decided to carry the amount forward

            to a future year.'
      - path: versions[0].formula
        kind: formula
        source:
          corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
          excerpt: 'If interest was paid on your student loan after 1997, but in 2024
            you did not calculate the amount that could be carried forward, enter
            the result

            of the following calculation on line 46: interest paid for 1998 through
            2024 minus the interest already used to calculate a credit for interest
            paid

            on a student loan for previous years.'
      - path: versions[0].formula
        kind: formula
        source:
          corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
          excerpt: 'Unused portion of the interest paid on a student loan (line 62
            of Schedule M for 2024

            or the amount shown in this respect on your 2024 notice of assessment)'
  versions:
  - effective_from: '2025-01-01'
    effective_to: '2025-12-31'
    formula: 'if schedule_m_carryforward_calculated_for_2024: schedule_m_unused_student_loan_interest_line_46
      else: schedule_m_student_loan_interest_paid_1998_through_2024 - schedule_m_student_loan_interest_used_for_previous_year_credits'

      - path: versions[0].formula

      - path: versions[0].effective_from

        source:

      - path: versions[0].effective_to

      - path: versions[0].formula
        kind: formula
        source:
          corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
          excerpt: Complete this schedule if interest was paid in 2025 on a student
            loan granted to you.
      - path: versions[0].formula
        kind: formula
        source:
          corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
          excerpt: Interest paid in 2025 on a student loan
  versions:
  - effective_from: '2025-01-01'
    effective_to: '2025-12-31'
    formula: schedule_m_unused_student_loan_interest_for_2025_line_46 + schedule_m_student_loan_interest_paid_2025_line_48
- name: schedule_m_student_loan_interest_claim_line_385
  kind: derived
  entity: Person
  dtype: Money
  unit: CAD
  period: Year
  source: Revenu Quebec Schedule M 2025, amount carried to return line 385
  metadata:

      atoms:
      - path: versions[0].formula
        kind: formula
        source:
          corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
          excerpt: Carry all or part of this amount to line 385 of your return.
      - path: versions[0].effective_from
        kind: effective_period
        source:
          corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
          excerpt: Amount carried to line 385 of your 2025 return
      - path: versions[0].effective_from
        kind: effective_period
        source:
          corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
          excerpt: Revenu Quebec Schedule M 2025 - Interest Paid on a Student Loan
      - path: versions[0].effective_to
        kind: effective_period
        source:
          corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
          excerpt: Revenu Quebec Schedule M 2025 - Interest Paid on a Student Loan
      - path: versions[0].formula
        kind: formula
        source:
          corpus_citation_path: ca/policy/revenu-quebec/tp1-2025/schedule-m-student-loan-interest
          excerpt: Amount carried to line 385 of your 2025 return
  versions:

    effective_to: '2025-12-31'
    formula: min(schedule_m_student_loan_interest_available_line_52, max(0, schedule_m_student_loan_interest_claimed_line_60))

  versions:

source:
Revenu Quebec Schedule M 2025 - Interest Paid on a Student Loan

T P -1. D. M -V (2025-12)
T

Interest Paid on a Student Loan

SCHEDULE

M

Complete this schedule if interest was paid in 2025 on a student loan granted to you.
Also complete this schedule if, for 2024, you calculated an amount for interest paid on a student loan and decided to carry the amount forward
to a future year.
If interest was paid on your student loan after 1997, but in 2024 you did not calculate the amount that could be carried forward, enter the result
of the following calculation on line 46: interest paid for 1998 through 2024 minus the interest already used to calculate a credit for interest paid
on a student loan for previous years.
Unused portion of the interest paid on a student loan (line 62 of Schedule M for 2024
or the amount shown in this respect on your 2024 notice of assessment)
Interest paid in 2025 on a student loan
+
Add lines 46 and 48.
Carry all or part of this amount to line 385 of your return. 
Interest paid on a student loan =
Amount carried to line 385 of your 2025 return
–
Subtract line 60 from line 52.
 
Amount that can be carried forward to a future year =

Enclose this schedule with your return.
If you want to keep a copy for your records, see the guide.

Y4M1 ZZ 89527749

46
48
52
60
62

M
